name: ECTSum (Earnings Call Transcript Summarization, EMNLP 2022)
what_it_holds: Benchmark dataset pairing earnings-call transcripts with concise bullet-point summaries (from Reuters-style analyst wrap-ups), plus the ECT-BPS extractive+paraphrasing baseline code and processed data files under codes/ECT-BPS/*/data/. GPL-3.0 license, 88 commits, last update 8 Mar 2023 (Colab notebook for the paraphrasing module).
why_useful: Gives transcript-to-summary training pairs that could be repurposed as a proxy for 'what the sell-side extracted as the key guide items' from a call — directly relevant to modelling what management's guide is made of.
size_hint: not stated; benchmark-scale (thousands of call/summary pairs typical for this task)
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
why_all: Gives transcript-to-summary training pairs that could be repurposed as a proxy for 'what the sell-side extracted as the key guide items' from a call — directly relevant to modelling what management's guide is made of.

name: Earnings21 / Earnings22 (Rev.com ASR earnings-call speech datasets)
what_it_holds: Earnings21: 44 audio files (~39 hours) of 2020 earnings calls with transcripts, speaker labels, punctuation and entity tags. Earnings22: 125 files (~119 hours) of international earnings calls with transcripts, ticker symbols, HQ country and language-region metadata. Distributed via Git LFS; license not explicitly stated in the fetched README.
why_useful: Real, long-form earnings-call audio+transcript data (not just US large-cap) with entity/ticker metadata; useful as raw material for a from-scratch ABNB peer-call tone/ASR pipeline or for validating a transcript-sourcing method against ground-truth audio.
time_coverage: Earnings21: 2020 calls; Earnings22: not stated precisely
size_hint: Earnings21 ~39 hrs/44 files; Earnings22 ~119 hrs/125 files (Git LFS)
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora

name: earningscall-python (EarningsCall API client)
what_it_holds: Python client for the (freemium/paid) EarningsCall API: transcripts at multiple detail levels (through word-level timestamps), audio downloads, slide decks, speaker/prepared-remarks-vs-Q&A tagging, and an earnings-event calendar; claims 5,000+ companies with an API key. MIT license, Python 3.10+, actively maintained (v2.0.1, 11 Mar 2026), CI via GitHub Actions.
why_useful: A structured, speaker-tagged, timestamped transcript API client (with a free tier for some data) that could shortcut point-in-time transcript acquisition for ABNB and peers, including audio/slide alignment for tone work.
size_hint: API client, not a static dataset; 5,000+ companies claimed

name: motley-fool-earning-transcripts (Datasette)
what_it_holds: Node.js scraper (index.mjs) with a GitHub Actions cron job that scrapes fool.com earnings-call transcripts into a Prisma-managed SQLite DB, served publicly via Datasette at motley-fool-earning-transcripts.fly.dev. 24 commits, no stated license; author disclaims commercial use.
why_useful: A running, automated, queryable (SQL via Datasette) mirror of Motley Fool transcripts — potentially a faster point-in-time source than re-scraping fool.com directly, though it is itself a scrape of a site with anti-scraping terms (flag as method only, per project rule 6).

name: IBM earnings_call dataset (Lelli et al., DataverseNL)
what_it_holds: 21,887 rows / 21.1MB: 188 earnings-call transcripts (Thomson Reuters Eikon) for 11 NASDAQ companies, 2016-2020, joined with ~13,200 daily stock-price rows (Yahoo Finance: OHLCV + adjusted close) and sentiment annotations across three subsets. CC0-1.0 (public domain). Originates from a DataverseNL deposit (point of contact Francesco Lelli) and is mirrored on Hugging Face; no primary GitHub repo found.
why_useful: A small but clean, public-domain, transcript+price-linked dataset with an explicit build methodology (Eikon transcripts joined to daily prices) — a template for building a similar ABNB+peers panel, and CC0 licensing removes reuse friction.
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
